enrichment.headline: Ratifies up to $48,300 for Envisioneers to run summer enrichment at West Oakland Middle School
enrichment.summary: The Board approves, after the fact, an agreement with Envisioneers, Inc. to expand summer enrichment and support services at West Oakland Middle School, alongside the regular summer school program. Students can join in-person or virtual afternoon activities that make up a 9-hour daily summer learning program. The provider also does recruitment outreach and grant reporting, and the agreement runs June 6 to July 8, 2022.

items.text: Ratification by the Board of Education of a Services Agreement 2021-2022 by and between the District and Envisioneers, Inc., Redwood City, CA, for the latter, in partnership with regular summer school program, to expand and enhance summer enrichment and support services for students; collaborate with the summer school site to provide afternoon in person and virtual enrichment opportunities based on preferences of the families, physical activities, and support services to enable students to participate in a 9 hour daily summer learning program; program activities based on youth development quality standards; work collaboratively with the District Summer Learning and After School Programs Offices; conduct outreach for summer student recruitment and communicate regularly with families over the summer; fulfill District grant reporting requirements, including submission of summer attendance records; and maintain regular communication with District Summer Learning and After School Programs Offices to review progress on summer program goals for the Summer Learning Program at West Oakland Middle School; have providers comply with 21st Century Community Learning Centers and Expanded Learning Opportunities Program grant requirements at West Oakland Middle School, via the Community Schools and Student Services Department, for the period June 6, 2022 through July 8, 2022, in an amount not to exceed $48,300.00.

enrichment.headline: Awards Bay Construction $1.153M to replace fire and intrusion alarms at East Oakland Pride Elementary
enrichment.summary: The district is awarding Bay Construction Company a contract to replace the fire and intrusion alarm system at East Oakland Pride Elementary, including new smoke, carbon monoxide and heat detectors and new alarm horns and lights. The $1,153,000 price includes a $25,000 contingency. Bay was the lowest responsive, responsible bidder, and work is planned from May 26 to August 24, 2022.
